create.name: Philip Goldberg
create.bio:
Philip Goldberg is a writer, meditation teacher, spiritual counsellor and ordained Interfaith Minister who has spent more than fifty years exploring how India's spiritual traditions took root in the West. Raised by atheist parents, he came to Eastern philosophy in the 1960s through the books of Alan Watts and Aldous Huxley. Through much of the 1970s he taught Transcendental Meditation before setting out on his own independent path, which he describes as that of a practical mystic living in the world.

His best-known book, American Veda, traces the influence of Vedanta and yoga on American culture from Emerson onwards. He followed it with a full biography of Paramahansa Yogananda, Spiritual Practice for Crazy Times, a toolkit of practices for staying calm and clear in turbulent years, and Karmic Relief, an exploration of what karma really means and how to apply it. He gives talks and workshops on karma, yoga philosophy and practical spirituality at universities, Vedanta societies and churches, teaches multi-week online classes, leads retreats and offers one-to-one spiritual coaching. He also hosts the Spirit Matters podcast and writes a regular newsletter on practical spirituality. In 2022 he and his wife, Lori Deutsch, moved from Los Angeles to Great Barrington in the Berkshires.

books.title: American Veda: From Emerson and the Beatles to Yoga and Meditation, How Indian Spirituality Changed the West
books.author: Philip Goldberg
books.description: A history of how the teachings of Vedanta and yoga travelled from India to America, and how they reshaped Western ideas about meditation, consciousness and the spiritual life.

books.title: The Life of Yogananda: The Story of the Yogi Who Became the First Modern Guru
books.author: Philip Goldberg
books.description: A full biography of Paramahansa Yogananda, author of Autobiography of a Yogi, following his life from India to his decades of teaching in the United States.

books.title: Spiritual Practice for Crazy Times: Powerful Tools to Cultivate Calm, Clarity, and Courage
books.author: Philip Goldberg
books.description: A practical guide to meditation and other spiritual disciplines for keeping a steady mind and an open heart when the world feels unsettled.

books.title: Karmic Relief: Harnessing the Laws of Cause and Effect for a Joyful, Meaningful Life
books.author: Philip Goldberg
books.description: Traces where the idea of karma came from and how it reached the West, clears up common misunderstandings, and shows how to live by karmic principles in relationships and choices.

books.title: Roadsigns on the Spiritual Path: Living at the Heart of Paradox
books.author: Philip Goldberg
books.description: Philip's reflections on the paradoxes seekers meet when they try to grow spiritually while living a full life in the everyday world.

courses.title: Spiritual Coaching with Philip Goldberg
courses.description: One-to-one spiritual counselling for people of any tradition or none, to help with confusing choices, paradoxes and practices along the path.
